scope: Read-only C04 integration seam inspection; no worker launched or qualified

observed_seams.requirement: Supply a pinned harness implementation that dispatches only a pre-reserved trial to its exact existing managed worker; retain upstream scheduling.
Transfer only the current prompt and workspace. Keep suite expected outputs, graders and future cases outside the worker.

observed_seams.finding: force_skill_invocation=false preserves the same prompt across arms; retain this setting for value trials.
Upstream budget enforcement is post-run. It cannot replace AEEP pre-dispatch authorization/reservation or uncertainty recovery.
The CLI baseline flag adds control trials to treatment trials; a complete runner inside one worker cannot establish separate arm isolation.

reuse_limits: ContainerExecutor preserves the local pinned-image command boundary but is not itself the managed capable-agent conformance proof.
Its cleanup and accounting semantics must be retained; Docker client CPU/RSS cannot become agent resource observations.
Do not expose a Docker daemon socket to the untrusted evaluator coordinator to make a harness callback work.
Common coordinator dependencies and trusted dispatch integration need an exact reviewed closure; the current private evaluator environment contains no full AEEP runtime.
next_safe_work: Resolve per-trial dispatch through the existing managed-host adapter and assessment repository; test before authorizing any new runtime provisioning or real-host execution.
